preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'VK?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of characters 'V', 'K', and '?'.
The total length of all strings across test cases must not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the number of possible periods followed by the periods in increasing order.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= d <= n for d in periods)
postconditions.description: All reported periods must be valid integers between 1 and n.
There must be at least one valid period for each test case.
